He has no access to the account files (CRM, profile and so on), so I couldn't look there for him. I didn't use `search_messages` or read anything outside his access.

The closest lead is the 9 June escalation in #central-team. It came from Marrow's "store ops" team, but nobody there was named. On our side, Pree handled the store follow-ups and Hollis handled setup and support (ticket PD-4821). I suggested he ask either of them, or the account owner, who his contact at Marrow should be.
